name: OREAL-DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. An RL post-train of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B (OREAL, outcome-reward RL), not a new base model: config.json unchanged, safetensors total 7,615,616,512 params as recorded for the base (label rounds to 7.616B). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-02-10. CAVEATS: the card's baseline column is marked with * - those numbers are copied from the base's own report, not re-run by these authors, so the comparison is same-table but not same-harness. The win is not a sweep: it TIES AIME2025-I (40.0) and LiveMath (65.6) and LOSES AIME2024 (50.0 vs 55.5).

benchmarks.name: MATH-500 pass@1 (%)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Evaluation Results' table: row OREAL-DSR1-Distill-Qwen-7B 94.0 vs row DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 92.8*, same MATH-500 column. LMDeploy inference, OpenCompass harness; * marks numbers copied from the base's own report. 7B block.

benchmarks.name: OlympiadBench (%)
benchmarks.config: Same table, 'Olympiad' column (OlympiadBench): this 66.1 vs base 64.1.

benchmarks.name: AIME 2025 Part 1 (%)
benchmarks.config: Same table, AIME2025-I column: this 40.0, base 40.0 - a tie, recorded to show the row is not a clean sweep.

benchmarks.name: AIME 2024 (%)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Evaluation Results' HTML table, AIME2024 column, row OREAL-DSR1-Distill-Qwen-7B: 50.0 vs its base DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B at 55.5* - this finetune is 5.5 points WORSE on AIME2024 and is recorded anyway because the card prints it. * marks numbers the card states are copied from the base's own report, so the comparison is across harnesses. Not from the card figure: figs/main_fig.jpg charts the 32B models only and has no 7B bar.

benchmarks.name: LiveMathBench (%)
benchmarks.config: Same table, 'LiveMath' column (LiveMathBench): 65.6 vs base 65.6 - an exact tie, so this row documents no gain. Text table, not a figure.
